test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that will improve the given sentence by using the most appropriate verb.

Soorya walking to college every day.

options.text: Soorya walked to college every day.
Soorya have walked to college every day.
Soorya is walking to college every day.
Soorya walk to college every day.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb form "**walking**".
 
• To convey a habitual action, the correct verb form should be "**walked**".
 
• The correct sentence should be "**Soorya walked to college every day**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Soorya** walked **to college every day."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "Soorya have walked to college every day," **– This option is incorrect because "have walked" is not appropriate for the given context.
 
• **Option 3: "Soorya is walking to college every day," **– This option is incorrect because it suggests an ongoing action that is not habitual.
 
• **Option 4: "Soorya walk to college every day," **– This option is incorrect because "walk" should be in the past tense "walked" to indicate a habitual action in the past.
